title: Nvidia Stock Surpasses 200!
full_monologue: **Nvidia Stock Just Hit 200 Dollars And AI Investors Are Panicking**. This surge isn’t just numbers on a screen—it’s a seismic shift in the AI landscape. With demand for GPUs exploding, everyone from startups to giants is scrambling to get their hands on the hardware. But is this a bubble or a breakthrough? The market is divided, and the question on everyone’s mind is: can AI keep up with this kind of growth? Let me know where you stand.
